purpose: Deliver the greatest viable human survival and recovery coverage under uncertain project completion without deleting any original research domain.
new_domain_slot_policy: Add six life-critical concepts as priority seed workstreams immediately; any formal reassignment of the 30 slots requires separately versioned scope mapping. Original 22 unbuilt topics remain in the priority list and are not deleted.
fundamental_immediate_action: Create an offline-read-first minimum survival reference and archive legally permitted authentic primary-source bytes with SHA-256 and rights, not just link-only cards.

tiers.P0: Life support, practical manufacturing, logistics, energy continuity and communication
tiers.P1: Recovery infrastructure, safety assurance, operating systems, biological prerequisites
tiers.P2: Advanced scientific and AI research; preserved but deferred

cross_domain_non_node_tasks.criterion: One portable index from medical/water/food/shelter/energy to existing verified content and missing critical source documentation
Rights-cleared authentic primary sources with local SHA-256, citation provenance, exact license and reproducible offline restore
Text-first human explanations with definitions, units, counterexamples, glossary and verification tasks; never require an LLM to decode the archive
Separate life-safety and physical-system checks from model simulation and mathematical consistency

stop_resilient_seed_release.rule: Publish minimum readable survival coverage for priority P0 workstreams BEFORE deepening specialized research to elaborate v1 manuscripts. Do not wait for polished 50-chapter packages.
per_workstream_minimum: Safe/prerequisite-focused reconstruction lessons and diagrams or textual equivalents
Independent source identities and license/rights metadata
Measurement units and simple reproducible calculations where valid
Known failure modes, critical hazards and explicit do-not-improvise boundaries
Offline read path and exact file integrity checks
Gaps and uncertainties clearly distinguishable from accepted science
stop_resilient_seed_release.science_acceptance: Provisional instruction/reference until competent field, clinical, construction or electrical review where required.

build_sequence: P0 survival seeds -> P0 depth and source acquisition -> P1 practical restoration -> P2 advanced domains -> all 30 content domains -> Bitwork routing -> integrated evaluation -> desktop transfer
